title: corylus sieboldiana var. mitis
intro: Corylus sieboldiana var. mitis, commonly known as Siebold's deciduous hazelnut or Japanese hazelnut, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Betulaceae family. It is native to Japan and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, improving blood circulation, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Corylus sieboldiana var. mitis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardioprotective properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and betulinic acid. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit potential therapeutic effects, including antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
